comparisons.peer_topic: Customer Concentration and Key Customer Risk
comparisons.peer_summary: Direct sales to a single distributor accounted for 28% and 21% of net revenue in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, with top five end customers representing approximately 40% and 35% respectively. The company expects significant customer concentration to continue and warns that loss of these customers could materially adversely affect business results.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AVGO disclose significant customer concentration in their fiscal 2024 results, highlighting specific revenue percentages attributed to single large customers or distributors. NVDA reports that sales to one direct customer ('Customer A') represented 13% of total revenue, with an additional indirect customer accounting for approximately 19%, noting that demand is expected to remain concentrated. Similarly, AVGO discloses that direct sales to a single distributor accounted for 28% of net revenue, and aggregate sales to the top five end customers represented approximately 40% of net revenue. Both companies explicitly warn that such concentration exposes them to risk if key customers reduce demand.

sentences.text: Sales to one customer, Customer A, represented 13% of total revenue for fiscal year 2024, which was attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

One indirect customer which primarily purchases our products through system integrators and distributors, including through Customer A, is estimated to have represented approximately 19% of total revenue for fiscal year 2024, attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.
Our estimated Compute & Networking demand is expected to remain concentrated.
A relatively small number of customers account for a significant portion of our net revenue.
Direct sales to one customer, which is a distributor, accounted for 28% and 21% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
We expect to continue to experience significant customer concentration in future periods.
The loss of, or significant decrease in demand from, any of our top five end customers could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
